answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 150047 Country: india Title: Is the company like KFC, al-Baik, MacDonald, foods are halal or haram? They saw halal certificate. Their certificate are valid or not valid they answered that link below: Question: Is the company like KFC, al-Baik, MacDonald, foods are halal or haram? They saw halal certificate. Their certificate are valid or not valid they answered that link below: Answer ID: 150047 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1017/1129/L=9/1438) You should avoid eating the meat about which you are not sure whether it was slaughtered according to Shariah or not. As those who issue halal certificate usually do not fulfill all the conditions hence merely by writing halal on the packet of meat it shall not be termed halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
